parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift`, a file whose path contains 'AnalyticsTesting' and whose type name is prefixed 'Mock' (`MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy+Playback`). Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a mock or test fixture must be treated as no-action. The production counterpart `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift` is intentionally mirrored by the mock for test-double purposes; the high Jaccard similarity (0.875) is expected and load-bearing for that fixture role. Lifting shared structure between the two would couple production analytics semantics to test-double infrastructure.
